description: This file defines a utility object SplitUtils that provides a function to split a string into tokens based on spaces and adds valid tokens to a custom LinkedList.

classes.name: SplitUtils
classes.description: A singleton object providing string splitting utility functions.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits the input string into tokens separated by spaces, returning a linked list of non-empty tokens.

methods.name: addIfValid
methods.description: Adds the token to the list if it is valid (non-empty).

methods.name: isTokenValid
methods.description: Checks whether a given token is valid (non-empty).
